findings.title: Small action button can lose right alignment after switching to flexbox
findings.body: `.small-action` is changed to a flex container, but the styles still rely on `float: right` for the action button and do not give `.small-action-desc` flexible growth or give the button `margin-left: auto`. In a flex row, floats on flex items are ignored and non-growing items do not fill the remaining width, so the button may no longer be pushed to the right edge as in the previous float/block layout.

findings.title: align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align for legacy Firefox flexbox
findings.body: The flexbox mixins emit legacy Firefox display values such as `display: -moz-box` and `display: -moz-inline-box`, but `align-items` does not emit the corresponding legacy alignment property `-moz-box-align`. Browsers using that legacy box model will not apply the requested `center` or `baseline` alignment.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items declaration
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a valid Microsoft-prefixed flexbox property. IE10/11 used `-ms-flex-align` for the old syntax or the unprefixed `align-items`, and the mixin already emits both. The extra declaration is invalid CSS and can trigger linter or validator failures.
